elements.requirement: A person subject to director disqualification sanctions commits an offence if that person acts as a director of a company or directly or indirectly takes part in or is concerned in the promotion, formation, or management of a company, subject to subsection (2).
elements.quote: It is an offence for a person who is subject to director disqualification sanctions to act as a director of a company or directly or indirectly to take part in or be concerned in the promotion, formation or management of a company

elements.requirement: The prohibition under subsection (1) does not apply to the extent that an exception from subsection (1) has been created by virtue of section 15(3A) of the Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Act 2018.
elements.quote: to the extent that an exception from subsection (1) has been created by virtue of section 15(3A) of the Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Act 2018

elements.requirement: The prohibition under subsection (1) does not apply to anything done under the authority of a licence issued by virtue of section 15(3A) of the Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Act 2018.
elements.quote: to anything done under the authority of a licence issued by virtue of section 15(3A) of that Act

elements.requirement: A person charged with an offence under section 11A has a defence if that person proves that they did not know and could not reasonably have been expected to know that they were subject to director disqualification sanctions at the time at which they engaged in that conduct.
elements.quote: a defence for a person charged with an offence under this section to prove that they did not know and could not reasonably have been expected to know that they were subject to director disqualification sanctions at the time at which they engaged in that conduct
